newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Euroyen, JGBs off highs after BOJ operation.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Euroyen, JGBs off highs after BOJ operation.

text.p: SIMEX Euroyen and Japanese government bond (JGB) futures failed to sustain their gains after receiving an early boost from the Bank of Japan (BOJ)'s unexpectedly generous money market operations on Friday.
The BOJ injected a net 200 billion yen into the money market in the morning, against a fund shortfall of 100 billion yen.
"It was the first such activity since August. The Euroyen and JGBs bounced up slightly on the back of it," said a trader with a U.S. futures house.
He said the contracts were pulled down from their highs when European players started trading in the afternoon.

December Euroyen was quoted at 99.21 at 1110 GMT against its IMM close at 99.20, after hitting a high of 99.23. March JGBs broke through the 126.41 barrier to hit a high of 126.48 before coming off to finish at 126.34 against their previous 126.33.
"In the short-term, the pressure for Euroyen is definitely to the upside," said the trader, adding that December was likely to trade in a 99.20-99.25 range for the time being.

Eurodollar futures finished little changed in fairly thin trade as players continued to digest the impact of Federal Reserve chairman Alan Greenspan's comments about a possible pre-emptive interest rate hike to check inflation.
"The downtrend is still quite strong but I think Greenspan's comments will cause a little volatility over the short term," said the trader.
September Eurodollars finished at 94.03 against their IMM close at 94.02 on volume of 8,130 lots.
